name: Normalized registration and learner defaults
description: Registration trims identity, lowercases email and requires a 12–128 character password at DTO boundary; Prisma defaults create LEARNER/ACTIVE.

name: Session token and account validity
description: Persist HMAC-SHA256 token hash, reject revoked/expired sessions and non-ACTIVE users. Session lifetime is seven days; logout revokes matching unrevoked token hashes.

name: Method role override and any-role matching
description: Handler role metadata overrides class metadata. Missing/empty role list passes; otherwise any matching role is enough. Insufficient administrative permission throws ForbiddenException.

name: Preferences use authenticated identity
description: Optional mismatched x-worklingo-account-id fails ACCOUNT_CHANGED. Preference lookup/upsert uses authUser.id; missing/unsupported stored locale projects as vi.

name: Draft edits use revision compare-and-set
description: Published/archived imports are immutable through edit/validate. Edit requires expected revision and DRAFT/VALIDATED status, increments once, sets DRAFT and clears validationHash.

name: Validation binds hash and blocking issues
description: Conditional validation matches ID/revision/hash/editable status. Only canPublish sets VALIDATED and validationHash=sourceHash. Analyzer checks source length above 500000 characters, section/activity limits 200/50 and listening audio references; controller distinguishes parse/validation errors.

name: Publication serializes allocation and replay
description: Actor/operation/key receipt, slug advisory transaction lock and import row lock protect publication. It rechecks revision/hash/state, materializes children, archives prior current, changes pointer and commits audit/receipt together.

name: Listening binds explicit current READY candidates
description: Selected IDs are distinct; each required script selects artifact from this import with matching slug, READY and exact script hash. Extraneous selected slugs fail. Transaction rechecks candidates before version binding.

name: Audio replay and freshness are separate
description: Generation request hash includes import/script selector/provider/voice/canonical config. Matching receipt replays acceptance. Pre/post synthesis script mismatch yields STALE; READY update requires GENERATING artifact.

name: Job replay checks identity rather than payload equality
description: Enqueue skips duplicate key and confirms creator/type/resourceType/resourceId. It does not compare payload, contentImportId or maxAttempts against existing row.

name: Claim locks and owner-attempt fences
description: Due PENDING/RETRY_WAIT needs remaining attempts; expired RUNNING is reclaimable. Claims use FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. Completion/failure matches RUNNING/owner/attempt but not wall-clock lease expiry.

name: Bounded code-specific retry
description: Runner requires retryable ProviderError and helper approval. Timeout/rate-limit/upstream retry below max; invalid/refused helper codes are eligible only at attempt 1. Delay starts at exponential 1s with 0.8–1.2 jitter, honors retryAfterMs within 60s cap. Live adapters mark refusals non-retryable, so their refusals never enter helper retry.

name: Owner manual retry grants one attempt
description: Status/retry API requires CONTENT_ADMIN or SYSTEM_ADMIN; service filters creator. Manual retry conditionally accepts FAILED/retryable, preserves identity, adds one maxAttempts unit and clears completion/errors.

name: Fixed-window limiting applies only to decorated operations
description: No RateLimit metadata bypasses guard. Decorated calls use HMAC subject hashes and PostgreSQL upsert by scope/hash/window; excess is 429 with rate-limit/retry headers. Login/register each declare 30 per 60 seconds.

name: Fallback is constrained independently of retryable flag
description: Required provider overrides preference. Account fallback cannot override system prohibition. One alternate requires enabled fallback, registered secondary and ProviderError other than refusal/invalid-audio/expired-recording; retryable flag is not tested.
